highlights.reason_zh: Kubernetes 自动恢复已进入可用商业版本，但 Minerva 仍是限量 beta，改变了 GPU 集群故障验收重点。
highlights.reason_en: Kubernetes recovery is now commercially available while Minerva remains a limited beta, changing GPU-cluster failure validation.

highlights.reason_zh: Cline 同时增强改动核对与失败恢复，直接影响 coding agent 是否会重复工作或卡住回合。
highlights.reason_en: Cline improves both change inspection and failure recovery, directly affecting whether coding agents duplicate work or strand turns.

highlights.reason_zh: LIFT-Bench 的代码与数据公开，可验证长文局部指令遵循，但 judge 依赖限制结果外推。
highlights.reason_en: LIFT-Bench publishes code and data for scoped long-form instruction following, while judge dependence limits generalization.

highlights.reason_zh: GitHub Agentic Workflows 把跨步骤凭据传递纳入静态分析，为 agent workflow 增加具体安全边界。
highlights.reason_en: GitHub Agentic Workflows brings cross-step credential handoffs into static analysis, adding a concrete agent-workflow safety boundary.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部成功，并补查官方文档、SEC、可靠媒体、开源、HF、论文、中文材料及重大综合新闻。Minerva、LIFT-Bench 与 InteractiveWorld 为补漏；厂商效果与研究迁移性尚未独立验证。Anthropic S-1 综合新闻补充见双语日报，提交注册不等于 IPO 完成。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded, supplemented by official docs, the SEC, reliable media, open source, HF, papers, Chinese-language material and major general news. Minerva, LIFT-Bench and InteractiveWorld are recovered misses; vendor effects and research transfer remain independently unverified. The bilingual daily carries the Anthropic S-1 supplement and distinguishes filing from a completed IPO.
